title: CleanComedy: Creating Friendly Humor through Generative Techniques

bias_targets.methodology: Automated filtering using toxicity classifiers (Detoxify for English, ruBERTConv for Russian) to detect and remove threats, obscenity, insults, and identity-based hate, followed by human evaluation of generation toxicity/inappropriateness.
Zero-shot classification using DeBERTa-v3-large to label and filter out jokes containing racist content or metaphorical insults.
Zero-shot classification using DeBERTa-v3-large to identify and remove jokes centered on political content.
Topic modeling using BERTopic (transformers and c-TF-IDF) to identify and remove joke clusters associated with religion.
Topic modeling using BERTopic to identify and remove dataset clusters targeting disabilities.
Topic modeling using BERTopic to discover and remove joke clusters based on nations or nationalities.
